items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: "Hey how’s the new Frank Zappa album?" You know. ... So he was my inside guy to music.

ctx.x: I like to talk about it and say, announce, “Okay here’s one of my desert island discs.” The first two jazz albums I bought — I would like to tell this story. I used to shop at Sam Goody’s in Center City, Philadelphia. And every week they would take out a column, kind of a big column, I’d say a third of a page top to bottom with a weekly ad in the Philadelphia Inquirer, the number one newspaper. And they would have different labels on sale every week. Okay? Oh my God all Warner Brothers is on sale, you know, and…
I have a guess, I’ll let Monk go first.
